0.original: Alphinaud has a mind to join the others at the High Crucible.

28.original: Speak with Krile at the Baldesion Annex.

48.original: Like his sister Tiamat, Vrtra is possessed of a gentle soul. I'm glad they're on our side.

49.original: The attendant was kind enough to give me directions to the High Crucible. First, let us return to the mulberry orchard.

50.original: I understand the mulberries are for the silkworms. Grown a stone's throw away from the satrap's residence... It gives it the quintessential Thavnairian flair, don't you think?

51.original: From here, we're supposed to follow the path left and past the mulberries...

52.original: The word Yuj apparently means “bind” in the local tongue, and this district is so named because it connects all others in the city.

53.original: If we manage to come this far, we shouldn't have trouble finding the High Crucible─or so I was told.

54.original: Where the street turns, enter the door straight ahead then descend the steps...

55.original: I thought the Crystarium was confusing, but it doesn't compare to Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han. The architecture and decorations make it even harder to get your bearings.

56.original: Anyway, let's see where this door takes us.

57.original: Whew, it seems we're on the right track.

58.original: And here is the aetheryte plaza. So far so good, and there isn't much further to go.

59.original: From here, we just need to cross to the other side of the hall, then pass through the larger of two doorways. The High Crucible lies beyond.

60.original: I suspect the others have already collected the warding scales. Come, let us join them.

61.original: You took your time. Got turned around, I take it?

62.original: Though this land hath been afforded a respite, in turmoil do many others languish still. Our work is far from finished.

63.original: What an immense laboratory... How many such places were enlisted to help forge the warding scales, I wonder.

64.original: Excellent. You're in time to hear the latest good news.

65.original: The Students have previously turned to Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han's alchemists for help with the analysis of various artifacts.

66.original: That is how I became acquainted with Nidhana. I'm glad we could rescue her, and pray she makes a full recovery...

67.original: I'm quite well now, I assure you. As they say, the stronger the taste─and stranger the color─the more effective the remedy.

68.original: With my body trying to replenish the aether I spent, however, I'm feeling rather famished...

69.original: I think a sampling of the local delicacies is in order. Hamsa cuisine would be a good place to start, perhaps?

70.original: As I heard it, after you defeated Nidhogg, his scales found their way into the hands of the Firmament's artisans.

71.original: Steeped in power as they are, it's no surprise that they were coveted. Still, it is a strange legacy for the vengeful wyrm.

72.original: We're last, of course, but at least we found the place.

73.original: The last thing I remember before being absorbed into the tower was you rushing towards me...

74.original: I can only imagine the hardships you and yours must have had to overcome to rescue us.

75.original: No amount of words will suffice to express my gratitude, but I hope the flower's radiant glow says everything I cannot.

77.original: It's good to be back, and with the fruit of our labors safely in storage!

78.original: For now, we have but to wait for the others to return from their respective meetings with the Alliance leaders.

79.original: As Thancred suggested, you should get some rest in the meantime!

80.original: Your chamber is comfortable, I hope? If it's cold in there, just let me know─we have plenty of blankets to spare.

81.original: Welcome back, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Krile has apprised me of your recent accomplishments. What an amazing feat to eliminate a tower, and pave the way to deal with the rest.

82.original: While it isn't much, I've changed your sheets and plumped up your pillow. After all, there's nothing like collapsing in a nice clean bed after completing a major malmstone, be it penning a thesis or defeating deiform entities!

83.original: So, would you like to take a look at your new and improved lodgings now?
